_about: Mods that are not in this repo but are referenced by name: they come with Herdr 0.1.12 and are replaced whole on every Herdr start (read-only for users). validate.mjs fails when a layout or mod source refers to a mod that is neither in mods/ nor 'shipped', and when a mod loads a file of another mod by path (no exception: icons are vendored into the mod that draws them).
